name: skills-cookbook
description: Ready-to-paste example prompts that teach efficient use of the hub's skills across thirteen tracks: project understanding (cognitive-load reduction), feedback and quality loops, product, marketing, design/frontend, the Karpathy method, Vercel/React, engineering quality, APIs and CLIs, mobile release, data/backend, knowledge/Notion, and meta-harness — plus a complete A-to-Z catalog index covering every plugin in the hub. Ships combination recipes and an anti-pattern matrix of mutually exclusive or redundant skills. Use when the user asks for example prompts, how to use a skill, which skills to combine, or how to understand a project with less cognitive load.
